html:
SMTO-LLM-0100 — The image model didn't send back a description

GUID: c41df86a-d8df-5abf-8548-b65705e2fded
Slug: attachment-vision-response
Domain: LLM · Subsystem: vision

What happened

  • SMTO asked the image model to look at your picture, but the reply was empty or unusable. Nothing about the image was reported back.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. In the same Conversation, ask SMTO again about just one image or page, with a short, specific question such as “What text is on this page?”. A smaller, clearer request is less likely to get an empty reply from the image model.
  2. Open Settings › Setup › Model routing and check which model the Vision card uses. If it says Use Main, your Main model is reading the images. A model that doesn't really handle pictures can send back nothing useful.
  3. If replies stay empty, choose a different image-capable model on the Vision card, select Save Vision, and start a new task. Some models return empty replies for certain images, and new tasks use the newly saved Vision model.

What success looks like

  • SMTO's reply describes what is actually in the image.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Until this works, don't rely on any SMTO answer about that image; it wasn't looked at.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The Vision observation call returned empty or non-text content, or attempted tool calls, so no observation was accepted.

What this means

  • The response was empty, nontextual or contained tool calls. Vision output is treated as untrusted observation data and cannot authorize tools. Diagnostic presentation does not grant access, change task configuration or establish the outcome of earlier operations.

Why this can happen

  • The response was empty, nontextual or contained tool calls. Vision output is treated as untrusted observation data and cannot authorize tools.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the exact error kind and retained source or route receipt. Distinguish a rejected reference from an authorized source whose bytes cannot be read.

How to fix it

  • Confirm the routed Vision (or Main fallback) model genuinely supports image input and returns text content for image_url parts with an empty tool list. Retry with one image or page and a focused prompt; if replies stay empty, switch the Vision role to a model that returns text observations.
  • Check the selected model’s image support and ask a bounded question about fewer images. Review the next response for actual content and coverage.

Retry and execution caution

  • Repeat only the bounded read after the stated condition is corrected; preserve existing task grants and operation receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • The model returns nonempty observation text without tool calls.

What not to do

  • Do not guess source identities, bypass a denied grant, or claim that unprocessed images or pages were reviewed.

Technical notes

  • Observation text and document contents are untrusted data. Existing skill grants, cancellation and resource limits still apply.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
